name: Atlassian Suite
description: Manages Atlassian credentials and identity handles (email, Jira base URL, Bitbucket workspace, Bitbucket username, Jira account id, a single Jira token plus an ordered list of Bitbucket API tokens with round-robin failover, all in SecretStorage) and exposes live Jira/Bitbucket REST probes that power ticket-existence checks, open-PR lookups, and per-token validation. Answers natural language sprint and board questions by forming JQL and querying Jira read only via the Atlassian MCP, and creates Bitbucket pull requests behind a confirmation gate. Also contributes the only two Jira writes Ghola permits, each behind its own independent gate that is off by default: POSTing a comment to an existing issue (Enable Jira Comment Write) and executing a workflow transition on an existing issue (Enable Jira Transition). Neither gate implies the other; once enabled each stays TPM-only, never autonomous, and gated on the operator approving the exact comment text or the exact resolved transition. Nothing else: no issue creation, no deletion, no assignment, no field edits, and no editing or deleting comments.

email.label: Atlassian Email
email.description: Email tied to your Atlassian account, used to authenticate Jira/Bitbucket API requests (ticket checks, PR lookups). The paired API token is stored separately in SecretStorage and managed from this panel.

jiraBase.label: Jira Base URL
jiraBase.description: Base URL for Jira ticket links: <jiraBase>/browse/<KEY>. Trailing slashes are stripped automatically.

bitbucketWorkspace.label: Bitbucket Workspace
bitbucketWorkspace.description: Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug scoping every branch/PR lookup. Blank auto-detects from origin's git remote URL. CRITICAL: a wrong or renamed slug makes find-pr silently report no PR even when one exists.

bitbucketUsername.label: Bitbucket Username
bitbucketUsername.description: Operator's Bitbucket handle (not display name), used to detect REVIEW mode when the open PR's author isn't this handle. Empty falls back to the git-author heuristic. Not a credential.

jiraAccountId.label: Jira Account / Username
jiraAccountId.description: Operator's Jira account identifier. Reserved for future assignee/reporter-based review detection; not yet wired. Optional.

boardId.label: Board Id
boardId.description: Jira agile board whose active sprint is queried. Empty queries by project and openSprints without a specific board.

boardUrl.label: Board URL
boardUrl.description: Optional board URL shown in answers so the user can open the board directly.

resultFormat.label: Result Format
resultFormat.description: How sprint and board query results are presented. table (default): columns for key, summary, status, assignee. grouped: grouped by status or by assignee. list: a plain list of key and summary.

includeDoneInSprintView.label: Include Done In Sprint View
includeDoneInSprintView.description: Whether a general sprint question includes Done items or only active work.

defaultTargetBranch.label: Default PR Target Branch
defaultTargetBranch.description: Branch new PRs target when running the create-pr verb, e.g. dev. Empty asks for the target branch each time.

createAsDraft.label: Create PRs as Draft
createAsDraft.description: When on, new PRs are created as drafts. Off creates ready-for-review PRs directly.

enableJiraCommentWrite.label: Enable Jira Comment Write
enableJiraCommentWrite.description: Off by default — every Jira comment-post request is refused outright, regardless of phrasing. On grants exactly one capability: posting a new comment to an existing issue. No other Jira mutation (create, assign, field edit, edit/delete comments, transitions) is enabled by this gate. Require Operator Approval below governs whether each post is previewed and confirmed.

attributionSuffix.label: Attribution Suffix
attributionSuffix.default:
---
Posted via Ghola on behalf of the ticket owner.
attributionSuffix.description: Appended verbatim to every posted Jira comment so readers can tell it's agent-authored. Shown in the approval preview. Empty disables attribution entirely — not recommended.

requireOperatorApproval.label: Require Operator Approval
requireOperatorApproval.description: When on (recommended), TPM must show the operator the final Jira comment text and get explicit confirmation before posting. Off removes the last check before a permanent, publicly-visible write — no workflow here is designed to run without it.

commentPolishPrompt.label: Comment Polish Prompt
commentPolishPrompt.default: Write a concise, professional Jira comment stating the update plainly. No hedging, no double-dashes, no severity ratings.
commentPolishPrompt.description: Instruction TPM uses when drafting a Jira comment from session material. Governs tone and shape only — the operator always sees and approves the final text.

enableJiraTransition.label: Enable Jira Transition
enableJiraTransition.description: Off by default — every Jira transition request is refused outright (enforced host-side, re-read on every request; the route answers 403). On grants exactly one capability: executing a workflow transition on an existing issue, by a transition id Jira reports as legal from its current status. No other Jira mutation is enabled — comment posting has its own separate gate above. The agent must still resolve the target by status name and show the operator the resolved transition before executing.
